description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Science & Research Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will own the hiring of the researchers and scientists who push our frontier models forward. You will partner closely with our Science leadership and research leads to find, engage, and secure exceptional talent: research scientists and research engineers.

You will also hire for Mistral Discovery, our initiative pushing AI development in real-world industries, bringing scientific talent to the problems where AI can have the greatest practical impact.

This is one of the most competitive talent markets in the world. You will be competing with the best-funded labs and big tech for a small pool of people, many of whom are not looking for a job. As an early member of the team, you will shape how we recruit scientists at Mistral and build the foundations to scale it.

What You Will Do

  • Source and engage world-class researchers through direct outreach, academic networks, publications, open-source contributions, and the international conference circuit (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR).

  • Build a deep understanding of our research areas and the wider AI research landscape, so you can hold credible conversations with scientists about their work and our research direction.

  • Partner with research leads and hiring managers to define role profiles, calibrate seniority, and align on what "exceptional" looks like for each research position.

  • Design and run interview processes adapted to research hiring, including research talks, paper discussions, technical deep dives, and applied problem-solving, while keeping them rigorous and respectful of candidates' time.

  • Own the candidate journey from first contact to signed offer, with particular care for passive candidates, senior researchers, and academics weighing a move from a lab or university.

  • Build pipelines early: PhD and postdoc talent, research interns and residents, and relationships with leading universities, labs, and research communities.

  • Navigate the complexity of international research hiring, including relocation, work authorization, and offer structure, in coordination with People Ops and Legal.

  • Advise on compensation, equity, and research-specific considerations (publication policy, research freedom, compute access) to craft compelling, competitive offers.

  • Use data to track pipeline health, conversion, time-to-hire, and market trends, and use those insights to refine our approach.

  • Build scalable systems, documentation, and best practices to support rapid growth in the research organization.

  • Act as an ambassador for Mistral's research culture, internally and externally.

  • Embrace hybrid work, with regular onsite collaboration in Paris to strengthen team connections.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience: 3+ years in recruiting in tech, ideally with experience in AI/ML, deep tech, or research-intensive environments.

  • Research hiring expertise: A track record of closing research scientists, research engineers, or PhD-level candidates in competitive markets, and the ability to evaluate profiles beyond keywords (publication record, research impact, trajectory).

  • Scientific fluency: Solid understanding of the AI/ML research landscape and the curiosity to keep learning. You can discuss a candidate's work with them and with our researchers.

  • Market savvy: Ability to own and execute searches independently in highly competitive talent landscapes, including passive and senior candidates.

  • Stakeholder influence: Ability to advise and align research leaders and senior scientists with credibility and diplomacy.

  • Data-driven mindset: Skilled at analyzing metrics to solve problems and optimize recruitment processes.

  • Global perspective: Experience with international hiring (including relocation and visa considerations) and fluent English communication. French is a plus.

  • Hands-on execution: Capable of balancing strategy with operational excellence, staying organized and disciplined.

  • Tool proficiency: Familiarity with modern ATS (e.g. Ashby), LinkedIn search, scheduling (e.g. Modernloop), and AI-driven productivity tools is a plus. Experience sourcing via Google Scholar, arXiv, GitHub, or Semantic Scholar is a strong plus.

Who You Are

These aren't buzzwords. They reflect what we look for in the people we hire, and what we have seen make the difference in this role.

  • Curious by nature. You learn constantly, and you dig into new research areas, tools and ways of working because you want to, not because you have to.

  • At home in pace and ambiguity. You thrive when things move fast and the path isn't clear, and you turn chaos into a clean state.

  • A proactive doer. You are highly efficient, you don't wait to be asked, and you turn ideas into real-life results.

  • A builder of better recruitment. You enjoy partnering with the HRBP team to constantly improve how we recruit.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.
